name: Siro
title: Give the SDR a better reason to start a conversation
subtitle: SDR effectiveness · Field-sales intelligence · Reliable data
focus: Find the right field-sales organizations and deliver reliable account context in the tools where SDRs work.
priorities: Build data flows across CRM, product and outbound systems.
Improve SDR effectiveness from day one.
Automate account research, enrichment and useful rep workflows.
Make the data dependable and measure adoption and GTM outcomes.
layers: Verify the field-sales model, team footprint and growth context.
Match the commercial owner and relevant contacts without duplicate outreach.
Give the SDR a useful reason to call and a reviewed opening.
Join rep feedback and product/pilot events to the account record.
rules: Hiring suggests research priority; it does not prove a coaching problem.
Do not infer conversation contents or employee performance from public signals.
Track an accepted SDR handoff separately from an email delivery.

personas.name: Field sales leader
personas.pain: Limited visibility into distributed in-person sales work
personas.promise: A conversation about the manager’s current review and coaching process.
personas.subject: How {{team}} shares field-sales learning
personas.email: Hi {{first_name}}, your public team growth suggests a useful question about manager workflows: how do good field conversations become learning the rest of the team can use? What does that process look like today?
personas.question: How do managers choose which in-person conversations need coaching?

personas.name: SDR manager
personas.pain: Research and tooling that do not help reps start better conversations
personas.promise: A clear ICP reason, verified owner and useful opening in the SDR workflow.
personas.subject: A better first conversation with {{account}}
personas.email: Hi {{first_name}}, I’d like the account brief to answer three rep questions: why this organization, why now, and what should I ask? Which of those takes your team the most manual work today?
personas.question: Which account facts consistently help an SDR earn the next conversation?

pitch: I have done the frontline sales work and know that a useful account brief must help someone start a better conversation. I also build the underlying tools: source-backed research, deduplicated CRM imports, pipeline stages and campaign drafts. At Siro, I would start with SDR effectiveness and make the data reliable enough that reps want to use it.
mappings: Zenefits sales development, enterprise outbound and startup messaging.
Start from the rep’s next conversation and useful account context.
Local CRM imports, provenance and pipeline stages.
Resolve identities and owners before activating another tool.
Hey Sammy pipeline and AI-assisted product development.
Build and measure a focused SDR workflow before expanding.
northStar: SDRs who can act on reliable account context
weekOne: A source-backed brief tested with two SDRs on one field-sales segment.
days60: Connect account research, CRM and outbound receipts; remove the largest reliability and ownership failures.
days90: Improve targeting and pilot handoffs from SDR and manager feedback, with adoption and meetings held visible.

sources.label: SDR-first mandate, data reliability, stack, requirements and compensation

firstBuilds.title: SDR account-intelligence brief
firstBuilds.goal: Put the evidence and next useful question in a rep’s hands.
firstBuilds.scope: 20 accounts and two SDRs with a manual research baseline.
firstBuilds.measure: Research time, factual edits, useful briefs and meetings held.

firstBuilds.title: CRM / outbound reliability
firstBuilds.goal: Stop duplicate and conflicting context crossing tools.
firstBuilds.scope: One SDR workflow and its current data sources.
firstBuilds.measure: Duplicate contacts, owner errors, freshness and accepted updates.

firstBuilds.title: Pilot-to-learning loop
firstBuilds.goal: Use customer workflow evidence to improve targeting and handoffs.
firstBuilds.scope: A small reviewed pilot cohort and an explicit success definition.
firstBuilds.measure: Manager adoption, useful coaching workflow and rollout decisions.
